remarks: Fabulous 3 bedroom, 3.5 bath townhome in the coveted Ainslie Square community. This bright and spacious home features hardwood floors throughout, beautiful chef's kitchen with Quartz counter tops & gas cooking, balcony and 2 car garage. Optional 2nd master bedroom as well! Enjoy all the amenities of the complex including pool, gym, clubhouse playground & fireplace pit. Walking distance to houses of worship & vibrant downtown Stamford. Minutes to Metro North & all major highways. Just move in and enjoy! Photos are prior to current tenant.
